tool_args.rationale: The paid observations show positive short-window gain and a negative response at long horizons. Fit competing sink-gradient couplings of a dual-timescale adaptation law numerically, then use fresh confirmation to test the selected fit.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available discriminating trajectory batch and long-horizon probe have already been acquired; the resulting 11 rows support numerical fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition or harmonic Lotka–Volterra oscillation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed time-dependent reversal and sink-gradient signature motivate testing a sink-modulated adaptation mechanism first.
It does not discriminate the target mechanisms.
